name: Citizenship Restoration (After Loss)

qualifying_event.description: A person who previously acquired Lithuanian citizenship by naturalisation and subsequently lost it may have it restored once, under Article 21 of the Law on Citizenship.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Proof of former Lithuanian citizenship and its loss.

requirement_groups.name: Former naturalised citizen who lost Lithuanian citizenship

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be a person who previously acquired Lithuanian citizenship by naturalisation and subsequently lost it, under Article 21 of the Law on Citizenship.
5 years of legal permanent residence in Lithuania.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of legal permanent residence in Lithuania.

requirements.blocker_text: Must possess legal means of subsistence.
Citizenship can be restored under this route only once.

evidence_required.document: Proof of former Lithuanian citizenship and its loss
Proof of 5 years' legal permanent residence
Proof of legal means of subsistence

sources.title: e-Seimas (Lithuania's official legislative database) -- Law on Citizenship, Article 21 (restoration of citizenship)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Lithuania). STATUS: DRAFT -- Article 21's title/existence confirmed against the e-Seimas table of contents; full text not independently re-quoted, the 5-year residence and means-of-subsistence figures modeled by analogy to lt_naturalisation.json's standard conditions rather than confirmed for this specific article -- flagged as an assumption, not a verified figure. dual_citizenship_allowed set false as this route is distinct from lt_citizenship_reinstatement_pre1940.json (which is available only to descendants of pre-1940 citizens, not to any former naturalised citizen) -- no basis was found to assume Article 7's exceptions extend to this general restoration case.
